# Wails v3 Documentation

> Build desktop applications with Go and modern web technologies.

## Documentation

- [Quick Start](https://v3.wails.io/quick-start/installation/): Install Wails and create your first application.
- [Tutorials](https://v3.wails.io/tutorials/overview/): Build complete applications step by step.
- [Core Concepts](https://v3.wails.io/concepts/architecture/): Understand the Wails runtime and application model.
- [Features](https://v3.wails.io/features/): Use windows, menus, bindings, events, dialogs, and platform integrations.
- [Guides](https://v3.wails.io/guides/): Configure, build, package, sign, and distribute applications.
- [API Reference](https://v3.wails.io/reference/overview/): Browse the Wails API reference.
- [Migration](https://v3.wails.io/migration/v2-to-v3/): Upgrade an application from Wails v2 to v3.
